Fixes for "Show amounts in".

- **Home, Activity and Insights open on your main currency**, the one most of your transactions use (your "Show amounts in" choice when set), instead of the alphabetically first one. Before, a single KWD purchase made Home open on KWD with nothing in it.
- **Built-in rates for KWD, AED, INR and TRY**, so purchases in these currencies are converted too. You can change them in Settings → Currency → Exchange rates.

APK: arm64-v8a, built and signed by GitHub Actions.
